name: Loss Masking
aliases: Loss Masking — Background Masking, L_mask, Mask Loss, Masked Loss Computation
definition: A technique to modulate loss terms for normals, ambient occlusion, and colors with the output mask, so that masked-out pixels (background) do not contribute to the loss function.
summary: Loss masking prevents background pixels from contributing to training loss by modulating intermediate feature losses, distinguishing itself from standard masking by explicitly handling normals and ambient occlusion.
